outcome: short-term outcomes of mothers and children
long-term outcomes of mothers and children
cohort: The study includes pregnant women enrolled in early pregnancy (less than 20 weeks' gestation) at Northwest Women's and Children's Hospital, along with their live-born children.
finding: This abstract describes the design, methods, and recruitment status of the Xi'an longitudinal mother-child cohort study, which aims to investigate the influence of external and internal factors on maternal and child health outcomes up to 12 years.
